name: Stalingrad 1942
storyline:
In the winter of 1942, the Battle of Stalingrad reaches its most desperate stage. As enemy forces advance through the devastated city, a lone defensive tank is ordered to hold the line against overwhelming attacks.

With no reinforcements coming, the tank commander must fight through endless waves of enemy armor, anti-tank guns, aircraft, and increasingly powerful commanders. Each sector becomes more dangerous, culminating in brutal boss encounters that test the limits of the last defender.

Armed with limited resources and surrounded on all sides, the commander pushes forward, collecting battlefield power-ups, repairing the tank, and destroying as many enemies as possible. The mission is simple: survive for as long as possible, break through every sector, and achieve the highest score before the battlefield finally falls silent.
summary: Stalingrad 1942 is a retro-inspired 16-bit arcade tank shooter from InfinitByte Studios. Take command of a defensive tank and battle through endless sectors filled with enemy tanks, anti-tank guns, aircraft, and powerful bosses. Collect power-ups, build massive combo chains, and survive as long as possible while chasing the highest score.
